ecosystem.title: From your firmware to the chip
ecosystem.alt: Layer diagram: your firmware calls kb-core, which calls brand-free chip drivers, which reach the hardware only through an MCU port; driver-template, espidf-tools and ci-tools start, build and check every repository.
ecosystem.description: Top to bottom, each arrow is a call. Your firmware calls the kb-core handlers, which call chip drivers (driver-<chip>), which reach the hardware only through an MCU port, yours or a ready one from kb-core; the port drives the chip on your board. Dashed cards are planned. On the right, the tools that every repository uses: driver-template starts a driver, espidf-tools builds and flashes ESP-IDF projects, ci-tools checks, documents and releases them all.
